questions.label: Code bug hunt (look-ahead / self-inclusion)
questions.expected: window includes bar i itself (close can never beat its own high) -> bars[i - 20:i]
questions.answer:
BUG: The slice `bars[i - 20:i + 1]` includes the current bar `i`, causing look-ahead bias by comparing the close against a high that may include the current bar's own high.
FIX: bars[i - 20:i]
